e.supportEnds: Caster death immediately removes its mark; a lethal counter cannot create a new mark; multiplier also rejects an orphaned legacy mark.

q.memberConditionUnchanged: Alive, able to act, not preparing a skill and an enemy within range; once per eligible member, no recursive card execution or companion turn/cooldown consumption.

changes.untouched: Traveler skills/profile, enemy HP/ATK/DEF/SPD/level, global growth, equipment, healing/food and lodging fees are unchanged by this support patch.
changes.overrideFinding: runtime_combat_v0148.js loads later and overrides the original E/Q in runtime_protagonist.js. Editing the earlier module alone would not tune the actual current kit.

assumptions.enemy: Native fixed four-person rule; no enemy stat/action edits.
assumptions.fixtures: Owned allies, equal levels/legal phase and talents, equal weapon/armor/accessory enhancement; no constellations or artifacts. One initial full HP only.
assumptions.actions: Native public COMBAT actions. Traveler Q then hold E; Isekai E marks a fresh highest-HP target then Q; alternate Q-first can be requested.
assumptions.recovery: Native MOVE with incidental battles and BUY lodging at HP below 50% or death; HP/PRNG carried between all fights.
assumptions.time: Displayed 2x uses internal rate 1 and presentationMs / 1000; 3 seconds per combat input, 6 seconds receipt/reentry, 4 seconds per move, 10 seconds lodging input/processing.
assumptions.limits: Human/network latency and acquisition grind excluded. Starting money is diagnostic funding, not income. Exact matchup outcomes are sampled, not a promise every composition wins.

comparisonMethod.counterfactual: Previous 20/12/.65 and final 30/18/.85 coefficients on the same frozen integrated runtime, replacing just those coefficients in the VM. Both arms retain the corrected caster-death handling.
comparisonMethod.winRateCaution: Successful clear time and failure-inclusive attempt time are separate; the Lv50 vape traveler loses seed 4242.

campaignScope.sixRoundsOfFarming: Six actual fights per campaign, with no artificial between-fight heal, native HP/PRNG carryover, native lodging and movement; final recovery paid when needed.
campaignScope.entryScope: Repeat campaigns use actual public DOMAIN_START, with actual road encounters. The daily-limited isolated boss profile is only a single-fight combat comparison.
campaignScope.bossRepeatDiagnosticDiscarded: An isolated boss-map repeat prototype lacked a legal inn round trip. It is excluded and replaced with native TAISHAN_MANSION:50; NO_INN here is a fixture limitation, not a diagnosed game bug.
campaignScope.finalHpLimitation: Final native lodging is followed by return MOVE and can suffer new road damage; original campaigns do not all finish at full HP. Their exact finalHp is retained. Separate --finish-at-inn reruns establish identical full-HP inn endpoints.

earlyFixture.limitation: Lv3 strength/roster fixtures use late progression gates in setup, so these 24 wins do not prove untouched first-story playthrough.

actualInitialGateCheck.name: fresh routes and the first joined companion keep actual early story and skill locks

results.name: support coefficients retain personal stats, four-person enemy difficulty, cooldowns and 60% ceiling
one live mark strengthens existing attacks, replaces itself and expires without stacking
protagonist death immediately removes exposure; no healing resurrection or saved support remains
joint strike preserves personal coefficient, attacks once per companion and consumes no companion turns or cooldowns
dead, incapacitated and preparing companions do not join; a solo protagonist cannot use Q
invalid legacy basic-attack metadata keeps the personal .65 joint fallback
existing injured saves and profiles reload without healing, repeat stat migration or altered equipment
an already saved old exposure keeps its original percentage and cooldown through reload
a native shield counter that kills the E caster cannot add a new orphaned exposure
fresh routes and the first joined companion keep actual early story and skill locks

finalSourceVerification.changeSinceMatrix: Only the additional a.hp > 0 guard after E damage. Main matrix and domain campaign initial enemy lists contain no MON_FATUI_ANEMO barrier owner; a separate native lethal-barrier-counter regression passed.

interpretation.strength: Lower personal stats and elemental absence remain. Four selected equal-level Lv50 parties perform better than Traveler in the isolated single-boss comparison while teammate damage accounts for most output.
interpretation.notUniversalUpgrade: Traveler retains advantages against multiple enemies. Some seed-specific fights/campaigns get slower or use more lodging Mora after the damage buff due to changed action/roll/target/healing sequences; no claim that every party, stage or economy route improves.
interpretation.fiveStarScope: One representative standard five-star party at Lv50 and Lv60, no constellations or artifacts; not exhaustive C6/high-artifact/future-character coverage.
interpretation.statistics: Two fixed seeds per single-fight condition, one seed per six-fight campaign. This validates the intended conditional role and catches regressions, not a precise population-wide win rate.

commonInnEndpointScope.endpointPolicy: Keep the existing six native DOMAIN_START fights and intermediate HP<50%/KO round-trip recovery. Then use the same shortest-roundtrip/price-ranked legal inn selection and actual MOVE/road combats; BUY only if HP is missing, and stop at that inn without return travel.
commonInnEndpointScope.alreadyFullHpPolicy: Already-full party still MOVE/PLACE_ENTER to the selected inn, but does not BUY unnecessary lodging. No lodging transaction input/fee is charged; move inputs are charged.
commonInnEndpointScope.originalReturnPolicyPreserved: Existing --final-recovery still returns to the farming map and can take new road damage after its last inn BUY. These earlier observed rows and costs are preserved, but are not an identical full-HP endpoint comparison.
